summary.plain: A trap that floats ultracold neutrons above a surface of magnets so they never touch a wall, with a detector lowered into the trap to count the survivors after different holding times.
summary.technical: Halbach-array magneto-gravitational trap with a repulsive magnetic field gradient, spin-flip loading, an in situ detector and monitor detectors; no material walls for the stored UCN.

technology.quote: levitating polarized ultracold neutrons above the surface of an asymmetric storage trap using a repulsive magnetic field gradient
technology.value: Asymmetric magneto-gravitational trap levitating polarized ultracold neutrons with in situ neutron detection
